pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Khelo India / sports schemes

patterns: Few genuine PYQs: APPSC asks concept words (Convergence for ADP) and NITI hubs (Team India Hub = States-Centre, 2018).
Expected shapes: ADP launch year/coverage (2018, 112 districts), 3 Cs, AP aspirational districts list, NITI as nodal poverty-estimation body.
Trap: AP ADP list (Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, YSR Kadapa original) vs Kurnool/Anantapur distractors.
App adds index editions/ranks (SDG Index, EPI) - fine as current affairs but deeper than PYQs.
